translatorNotes: FLAG — LEGAL-ETHICS JURISDICTION SENSITIVITY: this post makes claims about what may and may not be automated in legal practice (conflicts screening, deadline/statute-of-limitations tracking, unauthorized practice of law, attorney supervision of automated output, client confidentiality/privilege). These duties differ by jurisdiction (US state bars, EU/LATAM bar rules, etc.). A qualified legal reviewer in the target market must confirm the Spanish wording does not overstate what automation is permitted to do or imply legal advice. Terms rendered conservatively but require native + legal review.

Legal glossary applied consistently: law firm → bufete (with 'despacho' used for variety where natural); attorney → abogado; matter → asunto; intake → admisión; conflicts screening / conflict checks → revisión de conflictos; engagement letter → hoja de encargo; billing → facturación; deadlines → plazos; statute limitations → plazos de prescripción; practice management system → sistema de gestión del despacho (and 'sistema de gestión de casos' for 'case management system'); malpractice → mala praxis; privilege/confidentiality → secreto profesional/confidencialidad (concept referenced). 'Clio' kept as-is.

'bufete' vs 'despacho': both used intentionally for natural flow; 'bufete' as the default noun, 'despacho' where repetition would read stiff and in the fixed glossary term 'sistema de gestión del despacho'. A reviewer may standardize to one if house style prefers.
Register: informal tú throughout, consistent with prior phases. No em-dashes used anywhere.

Kept exact: numbers, read-time (9 min de lectura), date (20 de agosto de 2026 / Agosto 2026 style), brand/tool names (Clio, n8n, Make, Zapier), acronyms (API, CRM, IA), 'Innovaria Tech Limited', email info@innovariatech.space, phone +1 601 860 1258. Currency: 'between one thousand and five thousand dollars' → 'entre 1.000 y 5.000 dólares'; 'low hundreds of dollars' → 'unos pocos cientos de dólares'.

Internal links repointed to /es: brand → /es; nav Servicios/Sectores/Casos de éxito/Nosotros/Blog/Contacto and their submenus → /es/...; body links (best-automation-tools-service-businesses, industries/legal, services/workflow-automation, how-much-does-ai-automation-cost, how-to-choose-ai-automation-agency) and all Related-reading links → /es/blog/<slug> or /es/<section>. English blog slugs kept unchanged. Footer company/services links → /es.
Left unchanged (per rules): /privacy, /terms, sitemap.xml, mailto:, tel:, LinkedIn author URL, Unsplash image URLs, gtag, og:image absolute URL. lang-switch EN link → /blog/<slug> (English source).
